decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a variety of options ranging from high-end home audio to rugged outdoor speakers. The Sonos Two Room Set (prod_030) is the highest quality but represent a substantial investment. The EDUPLINK (prod_051) and Altec Lansing (prod_045) are solid waterproof choices. However, the EWA A106 Pro (prod_192) is the standout choice for a portable speaker. Its combination of an extremely high volume of positive social proof (nearly 40,000 reviews), a high rating, ultra-portable design with a carrying case, and a very low price makes it an unbeatable value for a secondary or travel speaker.
